subject.title: [Feature]: Detect Containerized Environments and Disable Update Suggestions

question: Should detected container environments silently suppress configured background auto-update and all local update actions, or should the default preserve explicit settings and only change passive suggestions?
rationale: The PR changes stored operator update policy and user-facing update actions, and the correct default cannot be inferred safely from code alone.

options.title: Complete The Container Policy
options.body: Gate or replace passive hints, UI buttons, update.run, and background auto-update consistently, then document and test the chosen upgrade behavior.

options.title: Preserve Explicit Auto-Update
options.body: Only change passive suggestions by default while keeping update.auto.enabled honored until maintainers add an explicit container policy.

options.title: Accept Automatic Suppression
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally decide that detected containers ignore update availability and auto-update settings, but that policy should be documented before merge.

recommendation.title: Complete The Container Policy
recommendation.body: Gate or replace passive hints, UI buttons, update.run, and background auto-update consistently, then document and test the chosen upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is listed as project lead in CONTRIBUTING.md and has the deepest history on status update availability and the core auto-updater.
